The declared backup path (etc/default/fsblame) is a routine configuration file backup. There is no evidence of obfuscated code, downloads from unrelated hosts, data exfiltration, or execution of attacker-controlled content. The file contains only expected packaging metadata.

The sed command only adjusts the ExecStart path from /usr/local/bin to /usr/bin to match the package layout. There are no network requests to unrelated hosts, no obfuscated code, no eval/base64/curl|bash patterns, and no data exfiltration. All operations are consistent with ordinary binary-repackage packaging practice.
